from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """One company's non-operating expense data from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company's name as written")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The company's stock ticker code")
    non_operating_expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount of 营业外支出 (non-operating expenses)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    expense_quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the expense amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
